name: Elite: gamestate
summary: The screen table and the vectors, the commander record, the dashboard messages, the full-page messages, cash, legal status and cargo.

entries.name: ScreenBuy
entries.summary: ScreenTable 0: buy cargo (the key 2 docked)

entries.name: ScreenSell
entries.summary: ScreenTable 1: sell cargo (3)

entries.name: ScreenEquip
entries.summary: ScreenTable 2: equip the ship (4)

entries.name: ScreenGalaxy
entries.summary: ScreenTable 3: the galactic chart (I)

entries.name: ScreenLocal
entries.summary: ScreenTable 4: the local chart (O)

entries.name: ScreenData
entries.summary: ScreenTable 5: the data on a system (P)

entries.name: ScreenMarket
entries.summary: ScreenTable 6: the market prices (K)

entries.name: ScreenStatus
entries.summary: ScreenTable 7: the commander's status (L), also after a dock

entries.name: ScreenInventory
entries.summary: ScreenTable 8: the inventory (ENTER)

entries.name: CursorLeft
entries.summary: ScreenTable 9-15: the chart keys (ChartCursorKeys): 9 left (N, KeySteer bit 0), the cursor one x less (ChartLeft)

entries.name: CursorRight
entries.summary: 10: right (M), ChartRight

entries.name: CursorDown
entries.summary: 11: down (X), two y more, ChartDown

entries.name: CursorUp
entries.summary: 12: up (S), ChartUp

entries.name: CursorHome
entries.summary: 13: B (KeyChart bit 4), the cursor back on the current system (ChartHome)

entries.name: CursorDistance
entries.summary: 14: D (KeyChart bit 5), the nearest system's name and distance (ShowSelected)

entries.name: PlanetNameVector
entries.summary: 15: R (KeyChart bit 6), PLANET NAME? (PlanetNamePrompt)

entries.name: NextGalaxyVector
entries.summary: ScreenTable 16: NextGalaxy: no key and no caller asks for 16 (CallScreen gets 0-15), so it is never reached

entries.name: NewGameVector
entries.summary: NewGame $D298

entries.name: ClearScreenVector
entries.summary: ClearScreen $D61D: the page cleared, its frame drawn

entries.name: PrintOtherVector
entries.summary: PrintOther $D45F: the other token set

entries.name: ViewTextsVector
entries.summary: ViewTexts $DA7A: the view's texts and the countdown

entries.name: JumpKeysVector
entries.summary: JumpKeys $DBA2: the hyperspace keys (in the interrupt)

entries.name: PrintCodeVector
entries.summary: PrintCode $D425: the standard token set

entries.name: CommanderMenuVector
entries.summary: CommanderMenu $D90A: load or save a commander

entries.name: FullMessageVector
entries.summary: Vectors: a full-page message, the dashboard keys off, the mission question

entries.name: AddCargoVector
entries.summary: AddCargo $D190: a scooped item

entries.name: AddCashVector
entries.summary: AddCash $D1D9: a bounty

entries.name: AddCombatVector
entries.summary: AddCombat $D1C7: the combat score

entries.name: MissionDoneVector
entries.summary: MissionDone $D14D

entries.name: DamageVector
entries.summary: DamageItem $D1E9: a hit that went through the shields

entries.name: FullMessage
entries.summary: A game over page: SHIP BOARDED BY (other $0B), other token A ($0D PIRATE, $D4 THARGON) and S, THEY SHOW NO MERCY... (other $FF), a click, a key, the page cleared

entries.name: MissionQuestion
entries.summary: WANTED BY GALCOP: A BRAVE COMMANDER FOR A SPECIAL MISSION, ARE YOU INTERESTED (Y/N)? (other $DF); Y: state 3, flag bit 7 and the briefing (other $E0); any other key: state 0

entries.name: MissionDone
entries.summary: The Thargoid mission's award: the combat score's high byte one more, state 0, flag bit 3, IN APPRECIATION OF YOUR EXCEPTIONAL COURAGE ... (other $0A)

entries.name: ColourPage
entries.summary: Clear the page, other token $5C (a capital next), all 768 attributes E, the position HL, then other token D

entries.name: AddCargoSpecial
entries.summary: $FF: the cloak ship's canister: the cloaking device (flag bit 6), the combat score's high byte one more, CLOAKING DEVICE on the message line

entries.name: AddCargo
entries.summary: One unit of commodity A into the hold (one less free space), the message, and the legal cost of the contraband

entries.name: AddCombat
entries.summary: The combat score plus DE; a carry into the third byte flags the rating message ($D0C9)

entries.name: AddCash
entries.summary: The cash plus DE (a bounty) and the message ($D0C5)

entries.name: DamageItem
entries.summary: A random loss: below 1 the fuel, 1-6 a piece of equipment, 7-16 a unit of cargo (StarSeed's bits)

entries.name: NewGame
entries.summary: The default commander copied in, the chart cursor on Lave, the prices made (MakeMarket with its stock store patched to a NOP: the stock is the record's), the sun placed

labels.name: TunnelOn
labels.comment: A launch or dock tunnel is running

labels.name: TunnelLoop
labels.comment: The tunnel's frames run inside one call; the views are locked meanwhile

labels.name: CloakOn
labels.comment: Non-zero while the cloaking device is on (CloakKey): the view tinted blue, the energy drain one more; ENERGY LOW turns it off

labels.name: TextColumn
labels.comment: The print position: the column and the row

labels.name: MissileState
labels.comment: 0 off, 1 armed, 2 locked

labels.name: PrintTarget
labels.comment: The address of the printer's plot byte ($D548): $A9 (XOR C) mixes a glyph into the screen, $00 (NOP) writes it over (the dashboard's indicators)

labels.name: CrossX
labels.comment: The chart's crosshair: x, y and the circle's radius

labels.name: CommanderName
labels.comment: The commander record: the name, 10 letters and a zero

labels.name: LegalStatus
labels.comment: 0 clean, up to 49 an offender, 50 or more a fugitive; bit 6 set by a protected kill

labels.name: CombatScore
labels.comment: The combat score (the rating): the low byte, then two

labels.name: CommanderRest
labels.comment: The jumps, the galaxy, the cash and the price fluctuation

labels.name: CargoHold
labels.comment: The tons (or kg, g) of each commodity

labels.name: FreeSpace
labels.comment: The hold's free space in tons

labels.name: LaserMounts
labels.comment: The laser of each view: 0 none, 1 pulse, 2 beam, 3 military, 4 mining

labels.name: NovaMission
labels.comment: The record's +$2D: 1 in the system whose sun goes nova (JumpArrive after 32 jumps), until the jump out; the red tint, the refugees' question (RefugeeQuestion)

labels.name: Fuel
labels.comment: The fuel in tenths of a light year

labels.name: Missiles
labels.comment: The missiles fitted (0-4)

labels.name: Equipment
labels.comment: The equipment flags: the large cargo bay, ECM, two spare, the fuel scoop, the escape pod, the energy bomb, the energy unit, the docking computer, the galactic hyperdrive

labels.name: Seeds
labels.comment: The spare bytes, the galaxy's three seeds, the system's three seeds

labels.name: MarketStock
labels.comment: The station's stock of each commodity

labels.name: MissionState
labels.comment: The Thargoid mission: 0 none, 1 the MAYDAY heard, 2 not yet answered, 3 accepted, 4 in the galaxy's first system (the station a Thargoid base), $0C its station destroyed, 5 rewarded at the next dock

labels.name: MissionFlags
labels.comment: Bit 0 the nova started (32 jumps), 1 the cloak ship due (128 jumps), 2 the Thargoid MAYDAY started (254 jumps), 3 the Thargoid mission done, 5 refugees aboard, 6 the cloaking device owned, 7 the Thargoid mission accepted (the ECM jammer)

labels.name: RecordTail
labels.comment: The record's last nine bytes: the system docked at ($D0B2, $D0B3) and the sun's place

labels.name: SunGrows
labels.comment: Past the record: the sun's growth

labels.name: ChartCursorX
labels.comment: The chart cursor (galaxy coordinates)

labels.name: Messages
labels.comment: Ten message slots (MessageTick): a column (bit 7 the request) and a standard code each

labels.name: PrintCase
labels.comment: The printer's case state: the mode, the capital-next flags, the word buffering

labels.name: PrintPointer
labels.comment: The printer's patched address

labels.name: MissileTarget
labels.comment: The slot the missile is locked on

labels.name: AddCargoContraband
labels.comment: The legal cost of commodity A (BuyCheck enters here for each unit bought)

labels.name: DefaultCommander
labels.comment: The new game's commander: JAMESON, 100.0 Cr, 7.0 light years of fuel, a pulse laser, 3 missiles, galaxy 1 at Lave

labels.name: DefaultSun
labels.comment: The new game's sun and planet place
